{{Top|leg}}
The '''Week of Escape''' was a type of vacation to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]] that was available in the era of the [[Galactic War]] and subsequent conflicts. Participants signed a standard non-disclosure contract before the vacation, preventing them from mentioning any of the events of the Week of Escape once they left Zeltros.<ref>{{TORcite|type=|Item: "Zeltronian "Week of Escape" Voucher"}}</ref> It also had some spa-like features to it in order to help make participants feel more comfortable.

==Behind the scenes==
The Week of Escape was mentioned in the MMO ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the item description of the Zeltronian "Week of Escape" Voucher, a companion gift obtainable from [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] crates.
